name: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc.

profile.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing molecular technologies for targeted delivery of therapeutics to treat CNS malignancies such as glioma, glioblastoma and meningioma.

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track record 1: clinical programs advanced but no commercial launches; only $39,990 of right-to-try revenue [1]. AI 0: none evident. Market share 0: pre-revenue. Pipeline 1: named CNS cancer programs with clinical milestones but uncertain timelines [2]. R&D 1: spending is essentially all R&D, above peers.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission floor 2: clear aim of treating CNS cancers with targeted delivery [2]. No evidence found for community programs, retention, or insider buying; scored 0.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: Liquidity floor triggered: about 185,189 shares x $2.92 is roughly $0.54M daily, below $1M, so Infrastructure is 0. Revenue is $0, net loss was $14.2M in Q2 2026, and ROE and margin are unavailable or non-positive [1].

ai_resilience.label: MODERATE
ai_resilience.analysis: Drug development is regulated and physical-world, with clinical data and FDA approval as moats that AI cannot substitute; AI may accelerate rivals' discovery but not displace trials [2]. No AI revenue, so the tiebreaker is 0.

infinite_game.summary: Pre-revenue biotech with a genuine patient-focused cause, but dependent on repeated capital raising with a concentrated leadership structure.

just_cause.analysis: Treating intracranial malignancies is a genuine and distinctive cause, but untested through multi-year execution [2].

trusting_teams.analysis: No cultural red flags or retention data found; adequate by default [2].

worthy_rivals.analysis: No evidence of rival-learning language; competitive framing is not evident.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Too early-stage to have faced a pivot test.

courage_to_lead.analysis: Continuing heavy R&D spend despite losses ($14.2M Q2 net loss) is courageous but also necessity [1].

investment_thesis: NeOnc targets glioblastoma and other CNS cancers with novel delivery technologies, and any positive clinical readout could drive large re-rating from an $84M market cap [1][2]. Molecular technology IP gives optionality.
thesis_continued: No revenue, a Q2 2026 net loss of $14.24M (vs $5.68M a year earlier) and EPS of -$0.58 imply continued dilution [1]. The stock is below its 50-day average ($2.92 vs $3.86), illiquidity breaches the IOWN floor, and the CEO is also Executive Chairman and President, concentrating governance [2].
key_catalysts: Clinical trial readouts in glioma and glioblastoma programs
Regulatory designations or partnerships validating the delivery platform
key_risks: Continued equity dilution with widening losses
